purpose: Approval-only concept boards; not shipping assets

prompts.light:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a premium, high-fidelity French iPhone UI design approval board, landscape canvas, 4 equally sized portrait iPhone screens aligned in ONE row, full screens visible without cropping. This is a PROPOSAL for Inky Studio, a native iPhone companion controlling an e-ink picture frame. Use the provided approved older board ONLY as reference for the elegant black/white bento identity and photo subject style; redesign the details below. Do NOT replicate its large headers, skinny gray text or inefficient vertical spacing.
Overall title top-left: "Inky Studio · Bento 2". Subtitle: "Clair · Proposition à valider". Clean very light neutral board background, understated screen outlines, no glossy 3D phones. Four screen labels above: "01  Cadre", "02  File", "03  Historique", "04  Réglages".
Native iOS typography in French, compact bold headers directly beneath the status bar at a normal 16pt safe margin. NO large empty top area. One clear hierarchy. Canvas #F5F5F3, white cards radius20, text #111111, legible secondary #60606A, crisp subtle #DFDFE2 borders, blue #1E56C9 for actions and amber #916300 for schedule. 16pt horizontal padding, meaningful bento grid, SF Symbols-style consistent line icons. No irrelevant decorative charts. All text and labels should be legible and correctly spelled.
Screen1 Cadre: status9:41, compact top row "Inky Studio" bold28, second line small status dot with text "Cadre connecté". White primary card "Sur le cadre" with beautiful photographic Cassis Mediterranean coastal landscape at EXACTLY5:3 ratio, bold caption "Un matin à Cassis", secondary "Affichée à 08:00". Underphoto two equal outlined44pt buttons "Précédente" and "Suivante" with arrows. Underprimarycard two compact bento tiles: amberclock "Prochain changement" and "Demain, 08:00"; blue stackedimages "À suivre" and "3 photos". Full width blackbutton whiteplus "Ajouter une photo". Ensure button fully visible ABOVE bottom navigation, generous safe margin, no overlap.
Screen2 File: compact header "À suivre" with small blue circular plus top-right. Subtitle"3 photos dans la file". Three ordered roundedwhite photo rows/cards with landscape thumbnails of alpine lake, olive tree architecture, coast; names "Lac d’Allos", "Ombres d’été", "La corniche". First has smallbluechip "Prochaine photo". Visible action "Modifier la file" and supporting note "Organisez l’ordre des photos." DO NOT imply draggable handles alwaysactive. Aim thoughtful image-led dense layout.
Screen3 Historique: header"Historique", subtitle"Les photos déjà affichées". Section" Aujourd’hui" oneCassiscoastrow title"Un matin à Cassis" time"08:00", button"Remettre dans la file"; section"Hier" two thumbnails and names" Ombres d’été" time"18:30", "La corniche" time"09:00", same clear requeue action. Polished spacing, no destructive primary button.
Screen4 Réglages: compactheader"Réglages". Five clear white grouped cards/rows with icons and disclosurechevrons: "Programmation" subtitle"Chaque jour · 08:00"; "Image" subtitle"Couleurs et cadrage"; "Mon cadre" subtitle"Wi-Fi, connexion et mises à jour"; "Sécurité" subtitle"Face ID et mot de passe"; "Aide et confidentialité". Small bottomrow "Apparence" value"Système" is informational, no switch. Keep enough spacingandfootersvisible.
Allfour screens have consistent native4tabbottomnavigation with icons and labels "Cadre", "File", "Historique", "Réglages", correct tabselected oneach. Navigation reserves itsownarea abovehomeindicator; ZERO content/button hidden behindit. Realistic fullyimplementable SwiftUI screens, notwebsitecards. Footer ofboard"Maquettes de validation · Photos d’illustration · Fonctions proposées". No personalphotos. Do not put Bluetoothstatus onhome unlessframeisactuallypaired.
prompts.dark:
Edit the light board, preserving layout and photo content. Remove disclosure chevron from informational Appearance row.
Use case: ui-mockup. Create the DARK counterpart of a refined French Inky Studio bento iPhone app design board. Landscape canvas with FOUR full portrait iPhone screens in one row, discreet outlines, highly legible French text. Title "Inky Studio · Bento 2", subtitle "Sombre · Suit l’apparence de l’iPhone". Screen labels: "01 Cadre", "02 File", "03 Historique", "04 Réglages". The reference older board supplies the brand and photo style only; redesign the layout with compact headers and no reserved blank top space.
Dark palette: canvas #101012, cards #1C1C1F, text #F5F5F7, secondary #B0B0B8, border #343438, accent blue #91B9FF, amber #EABB63. Near-black, never navy/purple/neon. Natural-color photos, never inverted or dimmed. SF Pro-like native type; 28pt bold compact headers just below status bar, 16pt margins, 20pt card corners, 48pt actions.
Screen 1: "Inky Studio", status dot and "Cadre connecté"; card "Sur le cadre" with Mediterranean coast photograph at exact 5:3 ratio, caption "Un matin à Cassis", "Affichée à 08:00"; outlined actions "Précédente" and "Suivante". Below, two small tiles "Prochain changement" / "Demain, 08:00" and "À suivre" / "3 photos". White primary button with black plus and "Ajouter une photo", fully visible ABOVE bottom navigation with safe spacing.
Screen 2: "À suivre", blue plus, "3 photos dans la file"; three ordered photo cards "Lac d’Allos", "Ombres d’été", "La corniche"; first has a blue "Prochaine photo" chip. Clear "Modifier la file" button. Do not show always-active drag handles.
Screen 3: "Historique", "Les photos déjà affichées"; sections "Aujourd’hui" and "Hier"; coast and olive-tree photo rows with title, time and explicit "Remettre dans la file" action.
Screen 4: "Réglages"; organized dark grouped rows: "Programmation" / "Chaque jour · 08:00"; "Image" / "Couleurs et cadrage"; "Mon cadre" / "Wi-Fi, connexion et mises à jour"; "Sécurité" / "Face ID et mot de passe"; "Aide et confidentialité". Informational footer "Apparence · Système".
All four screens share native bottom navigation: icons and labels "Cadre", "File", "Historique", "Réglages", correct selected tab on each. Bottom navigation has its own reserved safe area; no content hidden behind it. Board footer "Maquettes de validation · Photos d’illustration · Fonctions proposées". Realistic buildable SwiftUI, polished and restrained, no decorative charts or gradients.
prompts.icons:
Use case: logo-brand. Create an expert design approval board of THREE redesigned iOS app icon directions for "Inky Studio", a minimalist black/white bento app for an e-ink photo frame. The old reference icon shows the concept but is too detailed; replace its miniature interface with big simple memorable silhouettes. Landscape off-white board, precise editorial typography. Title "Inky Studio · Une icône plus lisible".
Three equally sized columns A/B/C. Each shows one large rounded-square iOS icon, then the SAME design at small 60px, 40px, 29px sizes, plus a dark-appearance variant on charcoal. Exact labels "A · Le cadre", "B · Bento", "C · Inky". Black, off-white and ONE cobalt-blue accent. Flat vector-like crisp geometry, easy to rebuild in SVG/Icon Composer. About 18% safe inset. No micro lettering, no app screenshot, no tiny controls, no thin lines, no glossy 3D.
A (recommended): ink-black full squircle, a large thick off-white landscape frame occupying 72% width and 60% height. Thick frame stroke approximately 65px at 1024px. Inside ONE solid white mountain silhouette and one blue sun circle upper right. Clear and bold even at 29px. No extra tiles under the frame.
B: ink-black full squircle with THREE chunky rounded bento blocks: a dominant off-white horizontal top block containing a single bold negative-space landscape cutout, lower left off-white block and lower right blue block. Fat negative gaps, no fine details.
C: ink-black full squircle with a huge bold off-white lowercase "i" monogram stem with softly rounded square corners, plus an oversized blue dot about the stem width. Custom geometric mark, no other lettering.
Miniatures must match their large icon exactly. Labels stay OUTSIDE icons. Board footer "A recommandé · Validation de direction, pas encore l’asset final". High clarity, strong professional brand design.
prompts.flows:
Use case: ui-mockup. Make a high-fidelity French UI proposal board for Inky Studio: FOUR full portrait iPhone screens in a single row on a quiet light-gray landscape canvas. Title "Inky Studio · Photo, Wi-Fi et sécurité". Subtitle "Parcours proposés · À développer après validation". Premium black/white bento, off-white light canvas and charcoal dark canvas, compact bold native headers, 16pt margins, 20pt rounded cards, minimal blue accent. No large empty header space. Implementable SwiftUI, not website panels.
Screen 1, dark appearance: dimmed home behind a substantial dark bottom sheet headed "Ajouter une photo". Two large option rows with icons: "Prendre une photo" / "Utiliser l’appareil photo"; "Choisir dans Photos" / "Retrouver une image". Help text "Vous pourrez ajuster le cadrage avant l’envoi." Action "Annuler". No fake camera feed.
Screen 2, light: back "Mon cadre", header "Changer le Wi-Fi"; text "Restez près de votre cadre." Card showing a small frame icon, "Inky · Salon", checkmark "Cadre vérifié". Section "Réseaux détectés par le cadre". Three fictional network rows with Wi-Fi/lock icons: "Maison", "Atelier", "Réseau invité". Footer "Réseaux 2,4 GHz" and "Autre réseau". Network list is obtained by the frame, not the phone.
Screen 3, light: back "Réseaux", header "Connecter le cadre". SSID card "Maison", field "Mot de passe Wi-Fi" with masked bullets and an eye icon. Text "Votre iPhone doit pouvoir rejoindre le même réseau." Primary black button "Connecter le cadre". Quiet note "Un hôtel peut demander une étape de connexion supplémentaire." No success state before connection.
Screen 4, dark: back "Sécurité", header "Mot de passe du cadre". Text "Ce mot de passe protège l’accès à votre cadre." Three masked fields "Mot de passe actuel", "Nouveau mot de passe", "Confirmer le mot de passe", eye icons. Face ID informational row "La connexion Face ID sera mise à jour." White button "Enregistrer". Footer "Le mot de passe du Wi-Fi reste inchangé." Form fits within safe area, keyboard hidden.
No bottom tabs inside pushed Wi-Fi/security flows. Source-picker sheet may show the dimmed home tabs behind it. All fields/buttons have strong contrast. Board caption "Premier démarrage InkyOS : QR d’appairage unique → Wi-Fi → mot de passe personnalisé → première photo". This is a proposal, not a claim of implemented Bluetooth.
